name: Meguro (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Meguro ward emblem in white: an outlined six-pointed star with concave sides enclosing a ring with a horizontal bar.
history: Municipal flag of Meguro, a ward in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 October 1977.

features.role: Meguro ward emblem — an outlined six-pointed star with concave sides enclosing a ring with a horizontal bar
